name: berth
description: Deploy claims for Claude Code: refuses a deploy to a guarded environment unless you hold its claim. Claims are github/branch-deploy lock branches on your git remote, with an end time, an extend command and a reminder before you leave. Stdlib Python, no dependencies.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: standard asks you when berth cannot check a deploy and reminds you about held claims; strict denies in that case and asks Claude to release or justify a claim when it stops. Project files can only make this stricter.

fail_mode.title: If berth cannot check a deploy
fail_mode.description: When the remote cannot be reached or a config file is broken: ask you, deny the deploy, or allow it.

identity.title: Your name in locks (optional)
identity.description: Written as created_by in each lock. Use your GitHub login if your team also uses branch-deploy. Empty: your git user.name.

max_claim_hours.title: Longest claim, in hours
max_claim_hours.description: A claim or an extension runs at most this long from now (0.25 to 24).
